assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production sprite sheet for a cozy top-down 2D pixel RPG, matching a detailed 16-bit woodland life-sim: crisp stepped pixel clusters, dark muted outline, warm natural colors, small readable shapes, light from upper left. Transparent alpha background, no floor, no shadow, no text, no labels, no grid lines, no scenery. EXACT 2 by 2 evenly spaced sprite layout on a square canvas: top-left facing DOWN toward viewer, top-right facing LEFT, bottom-left facing RIGHT, bottom-right facing UP away from viewer. Subject: a stocky dark brown wild boar with short ivory tusks, bristly back, broad pink-brown snout.
